name: nerdynik-task-management
description: Conventions for running task lists that stay useful at scale: customer/project naming, labels as the cross-project correlation axis for practices and partners, role-level saved views, and an OKR structure spanning long-term objectives, mid-term key results, and short-term SMART goals across as many independently scoped goal sets as you track. Bundles the Vikunja MCP server, with the conventions written to port to other task trackers.

vikunja_url.title: Vikunja API URL
vikunja_url.description: Your Vikunja instance's API endpoint, including the /api/v1 suffix — for example https://vikunja.example.com/api/v1. Leave blank if you use a different task tracker.

vikunja_api_token.title: Vikunja API token
vikunja_api_token.description: Personal API token from Settings > API Tokens in Vikunja. Starts with tk_. Needs read/write scope on tasks, projects, and labels.
